name: publicWeb_listDevices
description: The public web's door to HC6.hcapp_listDevices (E9.F7.S19, the web member's device list). A thin 'wrap for writes' wrapper: it EXECs hcapp_listDevices with the browser's own device credentials and adds no checks of its own, so the web and the app cannot drift. Auth, permission gate and every rule live in hcapp_listDevices (the token must be signed for 'hcapp_listDevices', because the inner SP validates under its own name). Reachable only through PublicWebAdminApi behind HC_INTERNAL_SECRET. Returns hcapp_listDevices's rowsets unchanged. A read, not a write, but wrapped all the same so the device list cannot differ between clients.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: The calling browser's HC.Device id (the browser is a registered device). No SQL default.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Device-bound token signed for 'hcapp_listDevices' (the inner SP validates it under its own name via HC6.ValidateAppAuth). No SQL default.

rowsets.description: From hcapp_listDevices: Auth failure (ValidateAppAuth) returns the error detail alone and the SP returns.

rowsets.name: Envelope
rowsets.description: From hcapp_listDevices: On success: emitted before the query runs.

rowsets.name: Devices
rowsets.description: From hcapp_listDevices: One row per device, most recent sign-in first. WHERE d.UserId = @userId AND (d.removed = 0 OR d.PasskeyCredentialId IS NOT NULL).

columns.name: Label
columns.description: '<OperatingSystem or Harrier Central/Browser> on <platform>' — built from Device.OperatingSystem, IsMobile and HC6.DevicePlatformName(DeviceData).

columns.name: IsThisDevice
columns.description: 1 when the row is the calling @deviceId.

columns.name: AppVersion
columns.description: Device.Version as of the last sign-in; NULL when blank (564 rows platform-wide).

columns.name: AppBuild
columns.description: Device.BuildNumber as of the last sign-in; NULL when blank.

columns.name: HasPasskey
columns.description: 1 when Device.PasskeyCredentialId is set. The credential id and public key never leave the server.

columns.name: IsSignedOut
columns.description: 1 when Device.SignedOutAt is set — deliberately NOT from `removed`, which 300 legacy rows carry without meaning.

sideEffects: None on success. INSERT HC.ErrorLog then THROW on an unhandled error.

On an error that escapes the inner SP (or the EXEC itself) the CATCH rolls back, logs 'Unhandled error in publicWeb_listDevices' to HC.ErrorLog (HcVersion '<web>', deviceId) and re-THROWs, so the API returns 500.

codeSmells.detail: @deviceId, @accessToken (line 14-15) have no SQL default. A caller that omits one fails with 'expects parameter' before the SP runs: PublicWebAdminApi's catch logs only a generic exception row and returns 500, and the SP's own graceful checks and error envelope never run.
hcapp_listDevices' own CATCH logs to HC.ErrorLog and THROWs; this wrapper's CATCH (lines 25-31) logs the same error again before re-throwing, so one failure leaves two ErrorLog rows.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
